newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Gillette is a Salomon top pick.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Gillette is a Salomon top pick.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers analyst Carol Warner said Gillette Co is one of her "top picks" for 1997, with a 12-month price target of $90 to $95 on the stock.

-- "We continue to believe that Gillette is a stellar consumer products company, and its impressive market shares, top-line growth (twice that of some peers), margins, earnings growth and significant opportunites for future growth fully warrant a premium P/E multiple to that of its peers," Warner said.
-- Gillette shares were up 2-5/8 at 80-1/4, a 52-week high, in late-morning trade on the New York Stock Exchange.

-- Warner said Gillette's acquisition of Duracell International Inc should help growth accelerate, as will Gillette's focus on women's shaving products and the strength of the Clear Stick deodorant products.

-- said emerging markets, including the former Soviet Uion and China, have "huge" potential, and the company will ship its SensorExcel razor into India in the first quarter of 1996. India is the world's largest shaving market, Warner said.

-- She said her fourth quarter earnings estimate for Gillette, excluding the impact of the Duracell deal, is $0.59 per share, up from $0.52 a year earlier. For the year, her estimate is $2.15 per share excluding Duracell, and $2.20 per share including Duracell.
